Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: clean city-specific scenic stage for Travary mobile onboarding
Input images: Image 1 is the approved prop-free Bali stage, the composition and material reference only, not the geographic subject. Any Image 2 is the city's existing postcard as a geographic content reference only; discard its border and lettering.
Primary request: Create one NEW standalone opaque portrait scenery plate for Singapore (SG), a deliberate city override. Lower 65-100%: uninterrupted calm warm-cream paper stage/control floor with the same perspective and gentle floor light as the reference, no scenery spilling onto it. Right foreground around x=62-92%, y=42-71% stays unobstructed for the separately composited coral Travi: background scenery may continue but keep close bulky landmarks and protruding objects to the left. No character or character shadow. Landscape finishes at the floor boundary near 65%.
Constraints: geographic subject is Singapore (SG) only. Symbolic staged arrangements of real city cues are acceptable; do not pretend multiple remote landmarks form one literal viewpoint. Remove ALL Bali temples, terraces, volcano, tropical cliffs and vegetation unless actually appropriate for this city. Keep Travi, folio, tickets, dates, prices and animations as separate shared assets. No painted UI or text.
Avoid: people, characters, mascot, character shadow, folio, book, loose tickets, luggage tags, UI, lettering, signs, numbers, prices, dates, labels, logos, flags, watermark, device frame, postcard border, fantasy landmarks, glossy plastic. Output one scenery plate only.
